clue.text: Dead soldiers being buried — then it's right for me to appear?

definitions.text: Dead soldiers being buried — then it's right for me to appear?

indicators.note: soldiers being buried means the word for soldiers goes inside the word for dead

parts.note: the late are the dead
men are soldiers, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: A mourner wonders whether, with dead soldiers being buried, it is proper for them to turn up.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a mourner is exactly who appears when the dead are buried.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who mourns aloud at a burial is a mourner, the one expected to show up for the dead.

clue.text: Indian food cold? It can be extremely cold

parts.note: a balti is a curry dish cooked in a metal pan, popular in British Indian restaurants
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A curry gone cold, and then a remark about how cold something can get.
explanation.walkthrough: The informal British sense of the answer is 'freezing', as in 'it's Baltic out there'.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang uses the name of the northern sea for freezing weather, so it means bitterly chilly.

clue.text: If darling gets left out in dance that's unbecoming

indicators.note: the letters are made to dance, shuffled into a new order
gets left out means the letter for left is removed from the fodder

explanation.surface: A ballroom remark: if your darling is left out of the dance, that's a poor show.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing L from IF DARLING leaves IFDARING, which 'dance' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin-derived phrase means beneath one's dignity, which is what unbecoming behaviour is.

clue.text: People in pubs do this for a hen night

definitions.meaning: staff serving behind a pub counter

definitions.text: do this for a hen night
definitions.meaning: read as two words, a hen party will ..., keeping males out

explanation.surface: Pub staff are what a hen night calls for.
explanation.definitionFit: Bar staff are the people who serve drinks in pubs, and read as a phrase it means keep males out.

clue.text: Europeans about to besiege a parliamentary house

indicators.note: to besiege means to surround, so the reversed word goes round the letter a
about means the word for these Europeans is turned round

parts.note: Danes are people from Denmark

explanation.surface: Continental visitors are about to lay siege to a chamber of parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns DANES into SENAD, which then encloses A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish upper house, the senate of the Oireachtas, is a parliamentary chamber.

clue.text: One waiting for a computer

definitions.meaning: someone who waits at table or serves
a machine that supplies data to other machines on a network

explanation.surface: Someone waiting around for a computer to become free.
explanation.definitionFit: A waiter serves food, and a network machine that serves files is also called by this name.

clue.text: Home supporter on front of terrace, one expected to be childish

parts.note: in means at home
a fan supports a team

indicators.note: front of means the first letter of terrace is taken

explanation.surface: A home fan standing at the front of the football terrace, acting like a child.
explanation.walkthrough: The football picture misleads: the definition is one whom we expect to be childlike.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby or very young child is naturally expected to behave like a child.

clue.text: Secret society wants a new language in the kingdom

parts.note: a tong is a Chinese secret society

explanation.surface: A secret society wants to adopt a new language for the realm.
explanation.definitionFit: The Polynesian tongue spoken in the Pacific monarchy is named after the islands' kingdom.

clue.text: Primitive life form supporting an underground worker, if trapped

parts.note: for means in favour of, supporting
an gives the single letter A

indicators.note: if trapped means the word if is caught inside the underground worker

parts.note: a miner works underground

explanation.surface: A primitive creature backing a miner who is caught underground.
explanation.definitionFit: These single-celled marine organisms with chalky shells are among the simplest forms of life.

clue.text: A fellow overtakes third in marathon to get silver

indicators.note: third in means the third letter of marathon is taken

parts.note: a gent is a fellow, a man

explanation.surface: A runner overtakes the third-placed athlete in a marathon to win silver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overtakes' places the fellow just past the R, after the opening A.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry the term for silver or white is this French-derived word.

clue.text: Crook named Ron held until trial

indicators.note: crook, as in bent or out of shape, tells us to twist the letters

explanation.surface: A criminal called Ron is kept in custody awaiting trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A suspect held in custody before a court hearing is said to be kept this way.

clue.text: Hit band in hurry

definitions.meaning: a strip worn round the waist
rush along, as in ... down the road

explanation.surface: Someone strikes a band member in a rush.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means strike hard, a waist strap, and dash along at speed.

clue.text: Fish put on with no wine

parts.note: char is a fish of the trout family
to don is to put on clothing
nay is an old word for no

explanation.surface: A fish served up without any wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry white wine made from the grape of the same name.

clue.text: Checking people of fashion in English resort

parts.note: bridling means restraining or checking, as with a horse
the ton is fashionable society

explanation.surface: Keeping an eye on the fashionable set at an English seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: BRIDLINGTON is a seaside resort on the Yorkshire coast.
explanation.definitionFit: A seaside town in East Yorkshire is a holiday resort.

clue.text: Relation bitten by wild dog — almost frightening!

indicators.note: bitten by means the relation sits inside the dog's jaws
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the dingo is the Australian wild dog
an aunt is a relation

explanation.surface: A relative gets bitten by a wild dog: almost too scary!
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims DINGO to DING, which then holds AUNT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intimidating or discouraging is alarming, which is close to frightening.

clue.text: Old boy's now out of bed, maybe, in darkness?

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
the 's of boy's gives S
a patient who is cured may be out of bed

explanation.surface: Has the old boy left his bed, perhaps, in the dark?
explanation.definitionFit: Hidden or dimmed means shrouded, so something obscured is concealed in the dark.

clue.text: Endless event with 'orses getting worn out

parts.note: a hunt is an event with horses, and dropping the h as in ''orses' gives 'unt
old means worn out

explanation.surface: An endless event involving horses, all worn out.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped aitch in ''orses' is the hint to drop the H of HUNT too. 'Endless' looks like an instruction but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Untold riches are boundless ones, too many to count.

clue.text: An archaeological artefact may have been in shelter

definitions.text: An archaeological artefact may have been
definitions.meaning: an artefact may have been ... of the ground
a trench shelter for soldiers or a sports team

explanation.surface: An ancient find may once have been kept in a shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A trench shelter is so called, and a dig unearths finds the same way.

clue.text: Gold place in which land is mined for mineral

indicators.note: in which means the following goes inside the gold-place combination

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
a site is a place

indicators.note: mined suggests blown up, so the letters of land are scattered

explanation.surface: A gold site where land is being mined for minerals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mined' suggests a gold mine but is the anagram signal; 'in which' places the scrambled land between the two letters of the gold symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: An aluminium silicate found in metamorphic rocks is a mineral.

clue.text: Don Pasquale? Primarily fool taking title of respect

parts.note: an ass is a fool
U is a Burmese title of respect, as in U Thant
the setter Pasquale refers to himself as me

explanation.surface: A reference to Donizetti's opera Don Pasquale, its foolish title character taking a respectful title.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Primarily' sets the fool first in the charade. 'Don' reads as part of the opera title but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To don a garment or role is to put it on, to take it upon oneself.

clue.text: Tax cut

explanation.definitionFit: It is a duty on home goods and also a verb meaning remove surgically.

clue.text: OT prophet brings me out as king

indicators.note: brings me out means the letters of me are taken away

parts.note: Samuel is an Old Testament prophet

explanation.surface: An Old Testament prophet anoints someone as king.
explanation.walkthrough: Samuel anointed the first king of Israel, so the surface is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: He was the first king of Israel in the Old Testament.

clue.text: Foremost crossword compiler, almost sweet

parts.note: foremost means number one, written NO I

indicators.note: almost means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a setter compiles crosswords

explanation.surface: The top crossword compiler is nearly a sweet person.
explanation.definitionFit: A hazelnut chocolate is a kind of confection, a sweet.

clue.text: Clever stratagem in operation? It may mean you pay less

definitions.text: It may mean you pay less

parts.note: a coup is a clever, successful move
on means running, in operation

explanation.surface: A clever ploy in action that saves you money.
explanation.definitionFit: A voucher entitles the holder to a discount on a purchase.

clue.text: Maiden in love after party is likely to be dotty

indicators.note: after means the maiden-in-love string follows the party

parts.note: a do is a party
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A girl in love after a party is likely to be a bit crazy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dotty' looks like 'mad' but means covered in dots, as the game pieces are.
explanation.definitionFit: Each tile in this game is marked with spots, so it is literally covered with dots.

clue.text: Ecstatic after a second blessing

indicators.note: after means the ecstatic word follows a and second

parts.note: sent means carried away, ecstatic

explanation.surface: Delirious after a moment's blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: Approval or agreement is a blessing given to a plan.
